newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sons Gwalia Q1 gold output rises.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sons Gwalia Q1 gold output rises.

text.p: Sons of Gwalia Ltd said its equity share of gold production totalled 113,632 ounces for the three months ended September 30, a 17.5 percent increase on the 98,728 ounces produced in the previous quarter.
The Perth-based miner said that gold output at the Sons of Gwalia mine was 31,669 ounces, Laverton 8,964 ounces and Marvel Loch 22,786 ounces, Bullfinch 23,463 ounces.
All these mines are wholly owned by Sons of Gwalia and are in Western Australia.

The company's 62.2 percent owned Yilgarn Star gold mine in Western Australia gave it an interest in 18,872 ounces of production while the French Salsigne gold mine, which it has a 34.5 percent stake in, earned it production of 22,22,835 ounces.
The company said tenders for a trial underground mining programme were nearing completion and trial mining was scheduled to commence in December this year.
At 2.00 p.m. (0400 GMT), Sons of Gwalia shares were seven cents down at A$7.83.
